title: Review of Resources to be Deployed to Government Agencies to Handle Caseload with Increasing Number of Scams
what_it_is: Review of Resources to be Deployed to Government Agencies to Handle Caseload with Increasing Number of Scams

sections.label: Police Anti-Scam Command
sections.summary: The Police set up the Anti-Scam Command in March 2022 to consolidate scam resources and expertise across their units.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, the Police set up the Anti-Scam Command in March 2022, to consolidate and optimise resources and expertise in scams across all their units.

sections.label: Takedown of scam syndicates
sections.summary: In 2022, Police collaboration with foreign law enforcement agencies led to the takedown of 13 scam syndicates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In 2022, close collaboration between the Police and foreign law enforcement agencies led to the successful takedown of 13 scam syndicates.

sections.label: Suspects arrested, assets seized
sections.summary: About 1,000 suspects were arrested and over US$129 million worth of virtual assets were seized.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: About 1,000 suspects were arrested and over US$129 million worth of virtual assets were seized.

sections.label: I can ACT against scams
sections.summary: This year the Police and National Crime Prevention Council launched the "I can ACT against scams" campaign urging the public to take three key steps.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have stepped up our public education efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This year, the Police, together with the National Crime Prevention Council, launched the new anti-scam campaign called, "I can ACT against scams", which calls on the public to take concrete actions to protect themselves and their loved ones by taking the three key steps of ACT.

sections.label: Banking safeguards against scams
sections.summary: Banks are being discussed with on security-by-design and transaction limits, and MAS and ABS are introducing safeguards like removing clickable links and a cooling period.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: As such, we have been discussing with the banks to look at whenever they are pushing out new innovative products and services, that they have a security-by-design concept and to set transaction limits at reasonable amounts to prevent possible huge losses of monies, should customers unwittingly fall prey to scams.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I have mentioned earlier that to secure banking channels, the MAS has been working with the ABS to introduce additional safeguards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: This includes the removal of clickable links and emails or SMSes sent to consumers and the introduction of a cooling period for activation of a new digital token.

sections.label: Cooling period for new services
sections.summary: A cooling period for activating new services is an important step because people may unwittingly add scammers as beneficiaries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: They may unwittingly add beneficiaries to their banking services who may be scammers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: And that is why the introduction of a cooling period for the activation of new services is an important step.
